# Commands

Every `:Dotnet` command is also available as a Lua function, see [Lua API](#lua-api). Run `:Dotnet` without arguments to pick a command.

**Legend**

- `<Picker>`: the configured picker (`snacks`, `fzf`, `telescope`, or the basic fallback)
- `<Picker Default>`: picker selection that persists for future use
- `<DArgs>`: dotnet args (e.g. `--no-build`, `--configuration release`). Always optional
- `<sln>`: solution file (in some cases a `.csproj` or `.fsproj` is used as fallback if no `.sln` file exists)

## Vim commands

| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `:Dotnet add package` | Pick a NuGet package and add it to a project |
| `:Dotnet add package prerelease` | Same as `add package`, including prerelease versions |
| `:Dotnet build` | `dotnet build <Picker> <DArgs>` |
| `:Dotnet build default` | `dotnet build <Picker Default> <DArgs>` |
| `:Dotnet build default quickfix` | `dotnet build <Picker Default> <DArgs>` and opens build errors in the quickfix list |
| `:Dotnet build quickfix` | `dotnet build <Picker> <DArgs>` and opens build errors in the quickfix list |
| `:Dotnet build solution` | `dotnet build <sln> <DArgs>` |
| `:Dotnet build solution quickfix` | `dotnet build <sln> <DArgs>` and opens build errors in the quickfix list |
| `:Dotnet clean` | `dotnet clean <Picker>` |
| `:Dotnet createfile <path>` | Spawns a picker for creating a new file based on a `dotnet new` template |
| `:Dotnet debug` | Debug selected project |
| `:Dotnet debug attach` | Attach the debugger to a running .NET process |
| `:Dotnet debug default` | Debug the persisted default project |
| `:Dotnet debug profile` | Debug selected project with selected launch profile |
| `:Dotnet debug profile default` | Debug the persisted default project with selected launch profile |
| `:Dotnet diagnostic` | Workspace diagnostics using the configured default severity |
| `:Dotnet diagnostic errors` | Workspace diagnostics, errors only |
| `:Dotnet diagnostic warnings` | Workspace diagnostics, errors and warnings |
| `:Dotnet ef database drop` | Drops the database for the selected project |
| `:Dotnet ef database update` | Updates the database to the latest migration |
| `:Dotnet ef database update pick` | Opens a picker to update the database to a selected migration |
| `:Dotnet ef migrations add <name>` | Adds a new Entity Framework migration with the specified name |
| `:Dotnet ef migrations list` | Lists all Entity Framework migrations |
| `:Dotnet ef migrations remove` | Removes the last Entity Framework migration |
| `:Dotnet new` | Picker for creating a new project from a `dotnet new` template |
| `:Dotnet outdated` | Shows the latest package versions as virtual text in `.csproj`, `.fsproj`, `Directory.Packages.props`, `Packages.props` and `Directory.Build.props` files |
| `:Dotnet pack` | `dotnet pack -c release` |
| `:Dotnet push` | `dotnet pack` and push the package |
| `:Dotnet remove package` | Pick a NuGet package and remove it from a project |
| `:Dotnet reset` | Deletes all files persisted by easy-dotnet.nvim. Use this if unable to pick a different solution or project |
| `:Dotnet restore` | `dotnet restore <sln> <DArgs>` |
| `:Dotnet run` | `dotnet run --project <Picker> <DArgs>` |
| `:Dotnet run default` | `dotnet run --project <Picker Default> <DArgs>` |
| `:Dotnet run profile` | `dotnet run --project <Picker> --launch-profile <Picker> <DArgs>` |
| `:Dotnet run profile default` | `dotnet run --project <Picker Default> --launch-profile <Picker> <DArgs>` |
| `:Dotnet secrets` | Opens a picker for .NET user-secrets |
| `:Dotnet solution add` | `dotnet sln <sln> add <Picker>` |
| `:Dotnet solution remove` | `dotnet sln <sln> remove <Picker>` |
| `:Dotnet solution select [path]` | Set the solution file for the current working directory, or pick one when no path is given. Useful when the solution is outside the normal search depth |
| `:Dotnet terminal hide` | Hides the managed terminal panel |
| `:Dotnet terminal show` | Shows the managed terminal panel |
| `:Dotnet terminal toggle` | Toggles the managed terminal panel |
| `:Dotnet test` | `dotnet test <Picker> <DArgs>` |
| `:Dotnet test default` | `dotnet test <Picker Default> <DArgs>` |
| `:Dotnet test run-settings set` | Pick a `.runsettings` file for a project, applied when running tests through the VSTest adapter |
| `:Dotnet test solution` | `dotnet test <sln> <DArgs>` |
| `:Dotnet testrunner` | Shows or hides the test runner |
| `:Dotnet watch` | `dotnet watch --project <Picker> <DArgs>` |
| `:Dotnet watch default` | `dotnet watch --project <Picker Default> <DArgs>` |

## Internal commands

Server maintenance commands, mostly useful when troubleshooting.

| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `:Dotnet _server logdump` | Opens the easy-dotnet-server logs |
| `:Dotnet _server logdump buildserver` | Opens the build server logs |
| `:Dotnet _server logdump stdout` | Opens the easy-dotnet-server stdout |
| `:Dotnet _server loglevel <level>` | Sets the easy-dotnet-server log level (off, error, warning, information, verbose) |
| `:Dotnet _server restart` | Restarts easy-dotnet-server |
| `:Dotnet _server start` | Starts easy-dotnet-server |
| `:Dotnet _server stop` | Stops easy-dotnet-server |
| `:Dotnet _server update` | Updates easy-dotnet-server (`dotnet tool install -g EasyDotnet`) |

## Lua API

The command functions are registered by `setup()`.

```lua
local dotnet = require("easy-dotnet")
```

| Function | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `dotnet.add_package()` | Pick a NuGet package and add it to a project |
| `dotnet.add_package_prerelease()` | Same as `add package`, including prerelease versions |
| `dotnet.build()` | `dotnet build <Picker> <DArgs>` |
| `dotnet.build_default()` | `dotnet build <Picker Default> <DArgs>` |
| `dotnet.build_default_quickfix()` | `dotnet build <Picker Default> <DArgs>` and opens build errors in the quickfix list |
| `dotnet.build_quickfix()` | `dotnet build <Picker> <DArgs>` and opens build errors in the quickfix list |
| `dotnet.build_solution()` | `dotnet build <sln> <DArgs>` |
| `dotnet.build_solution_quickfix()` | `dotnet build <sln> <DArgs>` and opens build errors in the quickfix list |
| `dotnet.clean()` | `dotnet clean <Picker>` |
| `dotnet.create_item(path)` | Spawns a picker for creating a new file from a template in the given directory (used by the file explorer integrations) |
| `dotnet.createfile(path)` | Spawns a picker for creating a new file based on a `dotnet new` template |
| `dotnet.debug()` | Debug selected project |
| `dotnet.debug_attach()` | Attach the debugger to a running .NET process |
| `dotnet.debug_default()` | Debug the persisted default project |
| `dotnet.debug_profile()` | Debug selected project with selected launch profile |
| `dotnet.debug_profile_default()` | Debug the persisted default project with selected launch profile |
| `dotnet.diagnostic()` | Workspace diagnostics using the configured default severity |
| `dotnet.diagnostic_errors()` | Workspace diagnostics, errors only |
| `dotnet.diagnostic_warnings()` | Workspace diagnostics, errors and warnings |
| `dotnet.ef_database_drop()` | Drops the database for the selected project |
| `dotnet.ef_database_update()` | Updates the database to the latest migration |
| `dotnet.ef_database_update_pick()` | Opens a picker to update the database to a selected migration |
| `dotnet.ef_migrations_add(name)` | Adds a new Entity Framework migration with the specified name |
| `dotnet.ef_migrations_list()` | Lists all Entity Framework migrations |
| `dotnet.ef_migrations_remove()` | Removes the last Entity Framework migration |
| `dotnet.new()` | Picker for creating a new project from a `dotnet new` template |
| `dotnet.outdated()` | Shows the latest package versions as virtual text in `.csproj`, `.fsproj`, `Directory.Packages.props`, `Packages.props` and `Directory.Build.props` files |
| `dotnet.pack()` | `dotnet pack -c release` |
| `dotnet.push()` | `dotnet pack` and push the package |
| `dotnet.remove_package()` | Pick a NuGet package and remove it from a project |
| `dotnet.reset()` | Deletes all files persisted by easy-dotnet.nvim. Use this if unable to pick a different solution or project |
| `dotnet.restore()` | `dotnet restore <sln> <DArgs>` |
| `dotnet.run()` | `dotnet run --project <Picker> <DArgs>` |
| `dotnet.run_default()` | `dotnet run --project <Picker Default> <DArgs>` |
| `dotnet.run_profile()` | `dotnet run --project <Picker> --launch-profile <Picker> <DArgs>` |
| `dotnet.run_profile_default()` | `dotnet run --project <Picker Default> --launch-profile <Picker> <DArgs>` |
| `dotnet.secrets()` | Opens a picker for .NET user-secrets |
| `dotnet.setup(opts?)` | Configures the plugin, see [Configuration](./configuration.md) |
| `dotnet.solution_add()` | `dotnet sln <sln> add <Picker>` |
| `dotnet.solution_remove()` | `dotnet sln <sln> remove <Picker>` |
| `dotnet.solution_select(path?)` | Set the solution file for the current working directory, or pick one when no path is given. Useful when the solution is outside the normal search depth |
| `dotnet.stop()` | Stops running workspace sessions |
| `dotnet.terminal_hide()` | Hides the managed terminal panel |
| `dotnet.terminal_show()` | Shows the managed terminal panel |
| `dotnet.terminal_toggle()` | Toggles the managed terminal panel |
| `dotnet.test()` | `dotnet test <Picker> <DArgs>` |
| `dotnet.test_default()` | `dotnet test <Picker Default> <DArgs>` |
| `dotnet["test_run-settings_set"]()` | Pick a `.runsettings` file for a project, applied when running tests through the VSTest adapter |
| `dotnet.test_solution()` | `dotnet test <sln> <DArgs>` |
| `dotnet.testrunner()` | Shows or hides the test runner |
| `dotnet.try_get_selected_solution()` | Returns `{ basename: string, path: string }` for the selected solution |
| `dotnet.watch()` | `dotnet watch --project <Picker> <DArgs>` |
| `dotnet.watch_default()` | `dotnet watch --project <Picker Default> <DArgs>` |

Workspace diagnostics can also be requested with a severity filter:

```lua
local diagnostics = require("easy-dotnet").diagnostics
diagnostics.get_workspace_diagnostics() -- configured default severity
diagnostics.get_workspace_diagnostics("error") -- errors only
diagnostics.get_workspace_diagnostics("warning") -- errors and warnings
```
